findings.title: Inverted date range silently returns empty result
findings.problem: No validation that from is before to; when from > to the JPQL predicate (c.startDate >= :from AND c.startDate <= :to) forms an impossible range and produces an empty page.
findings.impact: Callers passing an inverted range receive a silent empty page with 200 OK and no indication the input is invalid; indistinguishable from a genuine no-match.
findings.recommendation: Before delegating to the service, check if (from != null && to != null && from.isAfter(to)) and return ResponseEntity.badRequest().build().

findings.title: Null startDate conferences vanish under any date filter
findings.problem: Conference.startDate carries no NOT NULL constraint; when any date filter is active the JPQL predicate (c.startDate >= :from) evaluates to NULL for conferences with a null startDate, excluding them.
findings.impact: Any conference created without a startDate disappears from all filtered result sets, making it unreachable through the search UI.
findings.recommendation: Add null-safe JPQL predicates: (:from IS NULL OR (c.startDate IS NOT NULL AND c.startDate >= :from)) and the equivalent for :to. Alternatively enforce @Column(nullable = false) at the entity level.

findings.title: Search term LIKE wildcards not escaped
findings.problem: The service wraps the user-supplied search string in %...% without escaping literal % or _ characters. These are interpreted as JPQL LIKE wildcards in the query.
findings.impact: A search containing % returns all conferences regardless of title or description; _ matches any single character, widening or narrowing result sets in caller-controlled ways.
findings.recommendation: Escape before wrapping: search.replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_").toLowerCase(), and add ESCAPE '\\' to the JPQL LIKE clause.

findings.title: Status parameter not trimmed before query
findings.problem: The status param is forwarded to findAllFiltered without trimming. UPPER(" UPCOMING") does not equal UPPER("UPCOMING") in SQL, so any value with leading or trailing whitespace silently returns zero results.
findings.impact: Any client whose URL-encoding or UI produces a padded status string receives a silently empty result set with no error signal.
findings.recommendation: Trim before delegating: String statusParam = (status != null) ? status.trim() : null; then pass statusParam to findAllFiltered.

findings.title: Filter change fires fetch with stale page number
findings.problem: Two separate useEffect calls handle filter reset (setPage(0)) and data fetch. When a filter changes while page > 0 both effects fire in the same render; the fetch runs with the old page value before the state update settles.
findings.impact: A spurious request fires with the new filter criteria but the stale page index; if this response arrives after the page-0 response it overwrites the correct result set, showing users the wrong page of data.
findings.recommendation: Merge the reset into the fetch effect by reading a ref that is reset synchronously before calling getConferences, or guard the fetch so it waits until page has settled to 0 after a filter change.

findings.title: Fetch has no AbortController cleanup
findings.problem: The fetch useEffect returns no cleanup function. Any in-flight request continues running after the component re-renders; a slow response from a prior filter state can resolve after the current one and overwrite it via setConferences.
findings.impact: Under normal typing speed or variable network latency, users see results from a superseded filter with no loading indicator, because the newer fetch already completed.
findings.recommendation: Create an AbortController at the top of the effect, pass { signal: controller.signal } to the fetch call, and return () => controller.abort() as the cleanup. Suppress AbortError in the catch handler.

findings.title: No debounce on search input
findings.problem: The search input's onChange handler calls setSearch on every keystroke. Since search is a fetch effect dependency, each keystroke triggers a new API call immediately.
findings.impact: A 10-character query fires 10 sequential requests; combined with the missing AbortController (CR-006) this maximises the chance of stale data being displayed and adds unnecessary load to the backend.
findings.recommendation: Buffer the raw input in a separate state variable and propagate to setSearch via a useEffect with a setTimeout of 300-500 ms, cleared on each keystroke.

findings.title: Frontend accepts inverted date range without user feedback
findings.problem: The fromDate and toDate inputs propagate directly to filter state with no validation. When fromDate > toDate the backend receives an impossible range and silently returns an empty page.
findings.impact: Users see an empty conference grid with 'No conferences match your search.' and cannot distinguish it from a genuine no-match; the invalid input goes unreported.
findings.recommendation: After either date input changes, check if fromDate && toDate && fromDate > toDate and display an inline validation message; omit the date params (or swap them) when passing to getConferences while the range is invalid.
